title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
availability_reason: 红箱与原生可交互蓝箱的运行时对照均无法在任务场景 / quest scene 中打开完整道具箱；该菜单依赖据点专属 UI 状态调度链，当前补丁不再提供安装。 / Runtime tests of both the red box and the normally interactive blue control failed to open the full item box in a quest scene; the menu depends on a hub-only UI state-dispatch chain, so this patch is no longer installable.
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Quest Red Delivery Box - Full Item Box (Experimental)

preimages.meaning: 红箱提示生成原本使用交纳箱资格参数 1；补丁改用补给箱资格参数 0，使任务进行状态下仍可注册交互。 / Red prompt generation originally uses delivery eligibility 1; the patch uses supply eligibility 0 so interaction remains registered during active quest states.
红箱原本注册交纳提示编号 15；补丁仅在红箱局部改用补给提示编号 14，以消除交纳专用红叉。 / Red originally registers delivery prompt ID 15; the patch locally uses supply prompt ID 14 for red so the delivery-only crossed prompt is removed.
红色交纳箱路径加载交纳数据管理器地址的高半部。 / Red delivery path loads the delivery-data manager address high half.
红色交纳箱路径读取交纳数据管理器。 / Red delivery path reads the delivery-data manager.
红色交纳箱原路径调用交纳清单准备函数。 / Original red path calls the delivery-list preparation routine.
红色交纳箱原路径为交纳菜单重新读取管理器。 / Original red path reloads the manager for the delivery menu.
红色交纳箱原路径调用交纳菜单构建函数。 / Original red path calls the delivery-menu builder.
红色交纳箱原路径检查交纳菜单构建结果。 / Original red path checks the delivery-menu result.

anchors.meaning: 提示构建器只把调用参数 r5 保存为本地提示资源编号。 / The prompt builder saves call argument r5 only as its local prompt-resource selector.
模式 1 路径把该编号传给提示图文查询。 / Prompt mode 1 passes that selector to the prompt visual/text lookup.
查询类型固定为提示图文类型 2。 / The lookup type is fixed to prompt visual/text type 2.
虚调用返回编号对应的提示图文。 / The virtual lookup returns the visual/text associated with that selector.
后续注册传入已解析的提示图文，而非原始编号。 / Subsequent registration receives the resolved prompt visual/text, not the original selector.
提示条目由已解析图文创建，确认动作仍由对象状态机独立分派。 / The prompt entry is created from the resolved visual/text; confirmation remains independently dispatched by the object state machine.
共用资格函数拒绝任务状态 8。 / The shared eligibility function rejects quest state 8.
共用资格函数单独识别任务状态 3。 / The shared eligibility function handles quest state 3 separately.
共用资格函数识别任务进行状态 5。 / The shared eligibility function recognizes active quest state 5.
共用资格函数识别任务进行状态 7。 / The shared eligibility function recognizes active quest state 7.
状态 5/7 下比较补给语义参数 0 与交纳语义参数 1。 / In states 5/7, the function distinguishes supply selector 0 from delivery selector 1.
补给语义参数 0 跳到允许结果。 / Supply selector 0 branches to the allowed result.
交纳语义在状态 5/7 返回 -1，导致红叉与交互注册被跳过。 / Delivery semantics return -1 in states 5/7, producing the crossed prompt and skipping interaction registration.
补给语义在状态 5/7 返回允许结果 0。 / Supply semantics return the allowed result 0 in states 5/7.
完整/受限道具箱共用初始化器保存模式参数。 / Shared item-box initializer stores its mode argument.
共用初始化器比较受限模式 1。 / Shared initializer compares restricted mode 1.
模式 0 使用完整道具箱菜单状态 6。 / Mode 0 selects full item-box menu state 6.
受限模式 1 使用菜单状态 3。 / Restricted mode 1 selects menu state 3.
原版蓝色补给箱继续注册独立交互编号 14。 / The original blue supply box continues to register independent interaction ID 14.
蓝色补给箱交互注册调用保持不变。 / The blue supply-box interaction registration call remains unchanged.
箱子交互函数比较蓝箱/红箱标志。 / Box interaction compares the blue/red selector flag.
非零标志只进入红色交纳箱分支。 / A nonzero selector enters only the red delivery branch.
红箱提示生成调用共用资格函数；只有其参数由 1 改为 0。 / Red prompt generation calls the shared eligibility function; only its argument changes from 1 to 0.
红箱提示生成要求资格函数返回允许值 0。 / Red prompt generation requires the eligibility function to return allowed value 0.
非零资格结果会跳过红箱交互注册。 / A nonzero eligibility result skips red-box interaction registration.
红箱继续使用与蓝箱相同的提示构建模式 1；只替换其本地提示编号。 / Red keeps the same prompt-builder mode 1 as blue; only its local prompt selector is replaced.
通过资格门后，红箱自己的调用点注册提示；蓝箱调用点不受影响。 / After the eligibility gate, the red-local call site registers the prompt; the blue call site is unaffected.
蓝色补给箱分派固定传入标志 0。 / Blue supply dispatch passes selector 0.
蓝色补给箱尾调用共用箱子交互函数。 / Blue supply dispatch tail-calls the shared box interaction.
红色交纳箱分派固定传入标志 1。 / Red delivery dispatch passes selector 1.
红色交纳箱尾调用同一箱子交互函数。 / Red delivery dispatch tail-calls the same box interaction.

summary: 红箱与蓝箱对照均无法在任务场景启动据点完整仓库生命周期；保留为不可安装的失败证据。 / Both red and blue controls failed to start the hub full-item-box lifecycle in a quest scene; retained as non-installable negative evidence.
